witness.quote: A person shall, when operating a vehicle, give his full time and attention to the operation of the vehicle.
witness.reason: Vehicle operation during travel can activate this duty independently of the curb.
required_context: Document curb position, adjacent travel areas and the ego route without inferring parking, stopping, a bus stop or an approaching emergency vehicle.
Establish curb location, adjacent travel areas and ego route; do not infer stopping, parking, a bus stop or an approaching emergency vehicle.
Establish municipal applicability and the applicability of supplied state definitions.
Identify the person, motor vehicle and interval of operation.
Identify the person, motor vehicle and operating interval; establish municipal applicability and preserve unresolved state-definition incorporation.
Preserve full time and attention and the recovered behavioral descriptions as uninterpreted standards; the law supplies no minimum observation window.

Preserve the proposed observations kin.yaw_rate, kin.position, drv.straddles_marking, kin.accel_longitudinal, drv.hard_deceleration, drv.time_to_conflict, dev.traffic_signal and kin.speed as surrogate evidence.
Provide compatible markings, signal and conflict context where needed to support those observations; do not fabricate events or infer attention from their presence or absence.
witness.subject_reason: This available party can be the person operating the motor vehicle; the duty attaches to operation rather than the catalog title alone.
